status: SOURCE-ONLY next stage after metric-only exact gates; no projection implementation in this commit
first_scope: Ordinary nested Struct Column/GetField paths selected from entries(). Row, entry and column values are eligible; logical opaque values remain whole terminals. No arbitrary ArrayFilter/Fold or logical representation API changes.
demand: Reuse the existing nested_projection dependency walk rather than a second expression evaluator. Union Column/GetField leaf paths across output expressions, preserve all whole-value consumers and key fields. Global/external/effect/unsupported expression contexts retain their existing whole affected value/route.

Derive a consumer-local narrowed output schema before MapRows child/schema/action freezing. Root field names may be unchanged while a nested Struct field set shrinks; this is still a real projection. Each GetField retains the same declared leaf dtype.

Build/query-prepare path tries and positional descriptors once. Preserve original Field metadata/nullability, ancestor masks, explicit zero-field Struct length, row key/column order and shared producer identity. No per-entry/schema/name search.
materialization: Reuse reviewed existing CaptureView implementation via a small public opaque prepared-array-projection wrapper re-exported by vail-execution. Keep the internal enum private; avoid duplicate Struct/List view implementations or large source moves. Existing RowCaptureView wraps the same machinery.

Extend EntryProjection with per-selected-field optional prepared nested views and selected target descriptors; bind narrow views before ALL concat/spill/take. Keep original input schema validation and source_batch_id/full source_batch_bytes spill and singleton charging unchanged.

Clip outer cell List/LargeList values to its referenced offset envelope before recursive Struct view, rebasing once only for nonzero origins. Entry route already accepts LargeList; this is not the separate unsupported row-capture logical type inference change. Preserve nested list gaps as logical spans; safe constructor work may still cover the referenced envelope.
Whole/opaque/shared consumers retain full corresponding values; omitted owners can remain retained via other views, so no owner release/zero-copy/CPU speedup claim.
public_baseline_and_controls: Extend existing public entry_consumer_projection fixture with an entry.meta Struct containing selected value and deep unused defined/hidden payload. Existing three keys/entry/list/ancestor null cases, duplicate rows and multiple source batches retain complete keyed outputs.

On unchanged metric-enabled baseline, a final map_rows projection using GetField(meta,value) must show the actual materialization allocation growth if the gap exists. No private plan assertion or benchmark matcher.

Compare narrow leaf, multiple selected leaves, whole+leaf output, shared wide/narrow consumers, ancestor-null/empty Struct and selected logical opaque terminals. Include nonnullable selected primitive with parent mask and hidden offset owner/gap controls.

Existing full-projection and forced-spill resource controls remain; both forced-spill paths still exceed ORIGINAL source budget and preserve observable writes. Allocation fixture creation/preparation excluded as in accepted prior tests.
source_bridge_next: After materialization-only proof, translate eligible extension output paths through Config row/cells/value/column mapping BEFORE child compilation to ordinary source paths such as [cells,entry,meta,value].

Initially support direct Read and transparent MapGlobals / Column/GetField aliases through MapRows. Preserve predicates, sorting, key dependencies and all nontransparent/effectful producer expression dependencies. Derive consumer-local Read options, never mutate frozen ConsumerScopeExec/shared producer/cache.

Use existing provider_with_nested_projection_paths / task_with_projection_and_nested_paths and scanner reader bridge; expose standard DataFusion projections/field expressions where semantics are proven equivalent. Native logical GetField currently lowers through logical_kernel; do not blindly replace it with SQL get_field and lose parent-null behavior.

Opaque transformations retain full affected source values and remain explicit open cases, rather than pretending a source read is pruned. Any broader alias/ArrayMap composition requires its own reviewed typed mapping.
source_read_acceptance: Persist public matrix source with nested unused payload, then execute normal public PreparedTable actions and inspect live bytes_requested via standard DataFusion metrics after draining streams.
Both duplicate-key MatrixEntriesByKeyRuns and unique-key/transparent-alias paths should be measured, with whole/shared/key/filter/order controls.

Use source-read payload large and varied enough to survive compression/coalescing. Positive full-value control must read the unused payload. Buffers can be warm; request counts are not elapsed timings.

Report allocation and requested-byte observations separately; requested bytes include footer/data/delete attempts and omit pre-execution catalog/snapshot IO. No physical disk/decompression/bandwidth or future-task-retirement claim.
retained_open: LargeList row-capture public type inference unsupported before specialization; separate API stage.
Array element demand beyond reviewed ordinary ArrayMap and opaque producer composition remains unsupported until separately implemented/proved.
Safe Arrow constructor masks can scan interior referenced envelopes.
resources: Local correctness/allocation/requested-byte tests allowed nice10/jobs2; no local benchmark/profile or cloud work.

prepared_view_contract.source: Retain exact physical source DataType in a small opaque prepared descriptor. EntryProjection validates the original full input schema before binding; that existing batch guard discharges descriptor validity for all nested bind_validated calls. No redundant deep schema comparison per nested field or per entry.
prepared_view_contract.output: Prepare and retain the ACTUAL output DataType returned by reused CaptureView fields, including original Field metadata/nullability and any selected positional reorder. Consumer schema/EntryProjection uses this actual descriptor, not an assumed logical to_arrow shape.
prepared_view_contract.API: A thin public PreparedArrayProjection wrapper re-exported by vail-execution; internal CaptureView enum stays private. prepare(source,selected) returns no view if unchanged or a prepared descriptor/error if incompatible. source_type()/output_type() expose immutable descriptors; bind_validated(array) borrows projected children through the existing safe constructors under the validated-source contract.
prepared_view_contract.boundaries: Ordinary Struct child narrowing; selected opaque values remain whole. Outer supported entries List/LargeList envelope clipping uses original typed offset width, no new row-capture LargeList logical inference support. Null masks and explicit empty Struct lengths remain observable.
